qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Patented Smart Cut wafer splitting technology provides engineering differentiation in RF-SOI and FD-SOI engineered substrates. However, customer concentration among a few foundries and fabless RF designers, combined with heavy fab capex requirements and rapid Chinese substrate overcapacity (notably in SiC), prevents structural pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC/pricing power, REJECT). Proprietary Smart Cut substrate IP is compromised by heavy capital expenditure intensity (€230M annual capex vs €91M FY25 net income), pronounced inventory cyclicality in smartphone RF chips, and rapid price erosion in Silicon Carbide substrates from expanding Chinese domestic capacity.
qualitative.evidence: Soitec's financial track record exhibits severe cyclicality and poor cash conversion. Net income dropped by 60% from €231.9M in FY23 to €91.2M in FY25, while annual capex absorbed €230M, leaving negligible free cash flow. Monopsonistic foundry customers (TSMC, GlobalFoundries) and aggressive price deflation in power electronics wide-bandgap substrates limit cycle-neutral pricing power and compress multi-cycle ROIC.
